name: eHand-16
summary: eHand-16 is HITBOT's five-finger dexterous hand for manipulation requiring coordinated motion and contact feedback. Its 20 degrees of freedom comprise 16 active axes and four flexible passive axes. The manufacturer describes fingertip tactile arrays, joint-torque and temperature sensing, and closed-loop torque/position control with impedance control for compliant handling. Drive, transmission and sensing are integrated into the fingers for mounting at a standard wrist-arm interface. CAN FD is the listed communication protocol. The stated 15 kg payload applies specifically to continuous grippin

description.en: eHand-16 is HITBOT's five-finger dexterous hand for manipulation requiring coordinated motion and contact feedback. Its 20 degrees of freedom comprise 16 active axes and four flexible passive axes. The manufacturer describes fingertip tactile arrays, joint-torque and temperature sensing, and closed-loop torque/position control with impedance control for compliant handling. Drive, transmission and sensing are integrated into the fingers for mounting at a standard wrist-arm interface. CAN FD is the listed communication protocol. The stated 15 kg payload applies specifically to continuous gripping in self-locking mode.
description.zh: 五指灵巧手，具有20个自由度，其中16个主动、4个被动。官网列明CAN FD、最大抓握力52牛、重复定位精度0.9毫米；15千克载荷适用于自锁抓持模式。
